title: WORLDVALUESBENCH: A Large-Scale Benchmark Dataset for Multi-Cultural Value Awareness of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Wasserstein 1-distance between language model-predicted value ratings and actual human survey response distributions from the World Values Survey across different continents (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, South America).

Measuring how well model predictions align with human value distributions across different educational attainment levels (primary, secondary, tertiary) using Wasserstein 1-distance to check for performance disparities.
Evaluating the Wasserstein 1-distance between model-generated answers and empirical human answer distributions across urban versus rural residential areas.
